en-US:
Version 1.10.0 - Device Sync & Fresh Design
• New: Sync your groups across devices over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or your own Google Drive — end-to-end encrypted, with per-device pairing • New: Home screen widget redesigned with Material You colors • Improvements: Faster expense entry with scrollable chip pickers for payer and category • Improvements: Settings reorganized for easier navigation, plus more reliable Play Store updates

zh-CN:
版本 1.10.0 - 设备同步与全新设计
• 新功能：通过 Wi-Fi、蓝牙或您自己的 Google Drive 在设备间同步群组数据 —— 端到端加密，按设备配对 • 新功能：主屏幕小组件全新设计，采用 Material You 配色 • 改进：付款人和分类选择器改为可滑动的芯片式布局，记账更快捷 • 改进：设置页面重新组织，导航更简单；Play 商店更新更可靠
